note: Hand-curated identity decisions applied by tools/lore/build_registries.py. 'merge' folds a name into a canonical record; only identities the text states, or puts beyond reasonable doubt, are merged. 'link' keeps both records but marks them as possibly the same. 'drop' lists placeholder names that are not entities. Every entry gives its basis.

Gandolf of the Bear.basis: Ursula names the slain Lord of Utterbol Gandolf of the Bear (BFOUR-C2).

Lord of Utterbol.basis: Every reference to 'Lord of Utterbol' falls in BTWO-C24 to BTHREE-C12, before Bull Shockhead's lordship; the safe-conduct names him Gandolf (BTWO-C30).

(unnamed) new Lord of Utterbol.basis: 'I am Lord of Utterbol and therewithal Bull Shockhead' (BFOUR-C3-P007).

(unnamed) brother of the Knight of the S.basis: The Captain of the Dry Tree is the Knight of the Sun's brother (BTWO-C1, BFOUR-C15).

(unnamed) lover of the Maiden of Bourton.basis: Follows from the Maiden being Ursula; same bloody-saddle story (BONE-C7, BTHREE-C11).

(unnamed) wise carline of the Dale of Lo.basis: The Teacher of Lore is the wise carline of the Dale of Lore, who sat with the Lady in the Dale and returned from the Well a score of years later (BTWO-C7-P031).

(unnamed) sage of the wildwood.basis: The sage dwelling in the wood under the mountains is the Sage of Swevenham (BTHREE-C3).

Folk Innocent.basis: Word-order variant of the same name.

(unnamed) Fighting Man rock.basis: Same carved black rock at the pass (BTWO-C39, BTHREE-C10).

Gate of the Mountains.basis: 'the Rock of the Fighting Man ... the gate of the mountains' (BTHREE-C8).

Vale Turris.basis: Given as another name for the Dale of the Tower (BTWO-C39).

Little Plain.basis: Names for the Plain of Abundance (BONE-C20).

(unnamed) Dry Tree champions.basis: Members of the fellowship referred to as a body.

(unnamed) Dry Tree riders.basis: Members of the fellowship referred to as a body.

Wall of Strife.basis: The Innocent Folk's name for the Great Mountains (BFOUR-C1).

(unnamed) king.basis: Short form used in the same tale (BTWO-C6, C7).
